options.content:
Outdoor Air Quality Pollutants
This dashboard summarizes the outdoor pollutants measurements with panels per each of them, under the series of temperature and humidity as reference. Since each panel contains a single type of measurement, units could be displayed and the filter precision do not reach the pollutant selector due to the type of visualization, already segregated, maintaining Pilot, Scenario, SubScenario, Area and specific Sensor ID, like in the other general dashboards.
More info about manipulating pannels in the Home screen

panels.description: Dashboard for outdoor Temperature. Filtering by pilot, scenario, sub_scenario, area and specific sensor device is possible.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "out_temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sensor_id =~ /^${sensor_id:regex}$/)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["sub_scenario"])
  |> distinct(column: "sub_scenario")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
